sources.title: OpenADMET CYP Blind Challenge - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: OpenADMET Blind Challenge: Predicting CYP Inhibition 🧬 The next OpenADMET blind challenge focuses on predicting Cytochrome P450 (CYP) inhibition. CYP enzymes are the primary drivers of xenobiotic metabolism, and unexpected CYP inhibition can derail drug discovery programs through unpredictable drug-drug interactions.

sources.title: OpenADMET CYP Challenge: Woong method report for September 2026 ...
sources.snippet: This report describes the predictions prepared for the 750 challenge compounds and submitted under the display name Woong on 15 September 2026. It covers direct-inhibition regression for CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, and time-dependent inhibition (TDI) classification for CYP2D6 and CYP3A4.
